title: Connect Claude to Business Central MCP: A Step-by-Step Guide
summary: This guide explains how to connect Claude AI desktop to a Business Central MCP server using a locally hosted Python proxy, eliminating authentication complexity. It covers setting up Azure AD app registration, configuring Business Central, installing the proxy tool, and updating Claude's configuration file.
key_points: Use a local Python proxy to simplify Claude-to-MCP authentication and configuration
Create an Azure AD app registration with specific redirect URIs and API permissions
Register the Azure AD app in Business Central via Microsoft Entra Applications
Install bc-mcp-proxy Python package and run setup to generate configuration files
Add the proxy configuration to Claude Desktop's claude_desktop_config.json file under mcpServers

quotes.text: To reduce the complexity required for Claude to connect, as well as facilitate other AI Agents, we will use a locally hosted Proxy.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core strategy to simplify MCP authentication by using a proxy instead of direct integration

quotes.text: You can now ask Claude questions about your Business Central data, and after a few prompts for your permission, it will provide results.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the end result - Claude can query Business Central data with proper authentication

quotes.text: This approach also works for VS Code and Cursor.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates the proxy method is compatible with multiple AI agents and development environments
